verses.original: Ἤγγιζεν δὲ ἡ ἑορτὴ τῶν ἀζύμων ἡ λεγομένη Πάσχα
verses.transliteration: Ēngizen de hē heortē tōn azymōn hē legomenē Pascha
verses.literal: Now the Feast of Unleavened Bread called the Passover was approaching

verses.original: καὶ ἐζήτουν οἱ ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ οἱ γραμματεῖς τὸ πῶς ἀνέλωσιν αὐτόν ἐφοβοῦντο γὰρ τὸν λαόν
verses.transliteration: kai ezētoun hoi archiereis kai hoi grammateis to pōs anelōsin auton ephobounto gar ton laon
verses.literal: and the chief priests and scribes were looking for a way to put Jesus to death . . . for they feared the people

verses.original: Εἰσῆλθεν δὲ Σατανᾶς εἰς Ἰούδαν τὸν καλούμενον Ἰσκαριώτην ὄντα ἐκ τοῦ ἀριθμοῦ τῶν δώδεκα
verses.transliteration: Eisēlthen de Satanas eis Ioudan ton kaloumenon Iskariōtēn onta ek tou arithmou tōn dōdeka
verses.literal: Then Satan entered . . . Judas - Iscariot who was one of the Twelve

verses.original: καὶ ἀπελθὼν συνελάλησεν τοῖς ἀρχιερεῦσιν καὶ στρατηγοῖς τὸ πῶς αὐτοῖς παραδῷ αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai apelthōn synelalēsen tois archiereusin kai stratēgois to pōs autois paradō auton
verses.literal: And Judas went to discuss with the chief priests and temple officers how he might betray Jesus to them

verses.original: καὶ ἐχάρησαν καὶ συνέθεντο αὐτῷ ἀργύριον δοῦναι
verses.transliteration: kai echarēsan kai synethento autō argyrion dounai
verses.literal: They were delighted and agreed to give him money

verses.original: καὶ ἐξωμολόγησεν καὶ ἐζήτει εὐκαιρίαν τοῦ παραδοῦναι αὐτὸν ἄτερ ὄχλου αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: kai exōmologēsen kai ezētei eukairian tou paradounai auton ater ochlou autois
verses.literal: Judas consented and began to look for an opportunity to betray Jesus to them in the absence of a crowd

verses.original: Ἦλθεν δὲ ἡ ἡμέρα τῶν ἀζύμων ἐν ᾗ ἔδει θύεσθαι τὸ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: Ēlthen de hē hēmera tōn azymōn en hē edei thyesthai to pascha
verses.literal: Then came the day of Unleavened Bread on which the Passover lamb was to be sacrificed

verses.original: καὶ ἀπέστειλεν Πέτρον καὶ Ἰωάννην εἰπών Πορευθέντες ἑτοιμάσατε ἡμῖν τὸ πάσχα ἵνα φάγωμεν
verses.transliteration: kai apesteilen Petron kai Iōannēn eipōn Poreuthentes hetoimasate hēmin to pascha hina phagōmen
verses.literal: Jesus sent Peter and John saying Go and make preparations for us to eat the Passover

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν αὐτῷ Ποῦ θέλεις ἑτοιμάσωμεν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan autō Pou theleis hetoimasōmen
verses.literal: Where do You want us to prepare it - they asked

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἰδοὺ εἰσελθόντων ὑμῶν εἰς τὴν πόλιν συναντήσει ὑμῖν ἄνθρωπος κεράμιον ὕδατος βαστάζων ἀκολουθήσατε αὐτῷ εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν εἰς ἣν εἰσπορεύεται
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autois Idou eiselthontōn hymōn eis tēn polin synantēsei hymin anthrōpos keramion hydatos bastazōn akolouthēsate autō eis tēn oikian eis hēn eisporeuetai
verses.literal: He answered . . . When you enter . . . the city a man carrying a jug of water will meet you Follow him to the house - he enters

verses.original: καὶ ἐρεῖτε τῷ οἰκοδεσπότῃ τῆς οἰκίας Λέγει σοι ὁ Διδάσκαλος Ποῦ ἐστιν τὸ κατάλυμα ὅπου τὸ πάσχα μετὰ τῶν μαθητῶν μου φάγω
verses.transliteration: kai ereite tō oikodespotē tēs oikias Legei soi ho Didaskalos Pou estin to katalyma hopou to pascha meta tōn mathētōn mou phagō
verses.literal: and say to the owner of that house The Teacher asks Where is the guest room where I may eat the Passover with My disciples

verses.original: κἀκεῖνος ὑμῖν δείξει ἀνάγαιον μέγα ἐστρωμένον ἐκεῖ ἑτοιμάσατε
verses.transliteration: kakeinos hymin deixei anagaion mega estrōmenon ekei hetoimasate
verses.literal: And he will show you a large upper room already furnished Make preparations there

verses.original: Ἀπελθόντες δὲ εὗρον καθὼς εἰρήκει αὐτοῖς καὶ ἡτοίμασαν τὸ πάσχα
verses.transliteration: Apelthontes de heuron kathōs eirēkei autois kai hētoimasan to pascha
verses.literal: So they went and found it just as Jesus had told them And they prepared the Passover

verses.original: Καὶ ὅτε ἐγένετο ἡ ὥρα ἀνέπεσεν καὶ οἱ ἀπόστολοι σὺν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: Kai hote egeneto hē hōra anepesen kai hoi apostoloi syn autō
verses.literal: When the hour had come Jesus reclined at the table with His apostles

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν πρὸς αὐτούς Ἐπιθυμίᾳ ἐπεθύμησα τοῦτο τὸ πάσχα φαγεῖν μεθ’ ὑμῶν πρὸ τοῦ με παθεῖν
verses.transliteration: kai eipen pros autous Epithymia epethymēsa touto to pascha phagein meth’ hymōn pro tou me pathein
verses.literal: And He said to them I have eagerly desired to eat this Passover with you before My suffering

verses.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐκέτι οὐ μὴ φάγω αὐτὸ ἕως ὅτου πληρωθῇ ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: legō gar hymin hoti ouketi ou mē phagō auto heōs hotou plērōthē en tē basileia tou Theou
verses.literal: For I tell you that I will not eat it again until . . . it is fulfilled in the kingdom of God

verses.original: Καὶ δεξάμενος ποτήριον εὐχαριστήσας εἶπεν Λάβετε τοῦτο καὶ διαμερίσατε εἰς ἑαυτούς
verses.transliteration: Kai dexamenos potērion eucharistēsas eipen Labete touto kai diamerisate eis heautous
verses.literal: After taking the cup He gave thanks and said Take this and divide it among yourselves

verses.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι οὐ μὴ πίω ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν ἀπὸ τοῦ γενήματος τῆς ἀμπέλου ἕως οὗ ἡ βασιλεία τοῦ Θεοῦ ἔλθῃ
verses.transliteration: legō gar hymin hoti ou mē piō apo tou nyn apo tou genēmatos tēs ampelou heōs hou hē basileia tou Theou elthē
verses.literal: For I tell you that I will not drink of the fruit of the vine from now on until . . . the kingdom of God comes

verses.original: Καὶ λαβὼν ἄρτον εὐχαριστήσας ἔκλασεν καὶ ἔδωκεν αὐτοῖς λέγων Τοῦτό ἐστιν τὸ σῶμά μου τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν διδόμενον τοῦτο ποιεῖτε εἰς τὴν ἐμὴν ἀνάμνησιν
verses.transliteration: Kai labōn arton eucharistēsas eklasen kai edōken autois legōn Touto estin to sōma mou to hyper hymōn didomenon touto poieite eis tēn emēn anamnēsin
verses.literal: And He took the bread gave thanks and broke it and gave it to them saying This is My body given for you do this in remembrance of Me

verses.original: καὶ τὸ ποτήριον ὡσαύτως μετὰ τὸ δειπνῆσαι λέγων Τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἡ καινὴ διαθήκη ἐν τῷ αἵματί μου τὸ ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἐκχυννόμενον
verses.transliteration: kai to potērion hōsautōs meta to deipnēsai legōn Touto to potērion hē kainē diathēkē en tō haimati mou to hyper hymōn ekchynnomenon
verses.literal: In the same way after . . . supper He took the cup saying This cup is the new covenant in My blood which is poured out for you

verses.original: Πλὴν ἰδοὺ ἡ χεὶρ τοῦ παραδιδόντος με μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης
verses.transliteration: Plēn idou hē cheir tou paradidontos me met’ emou epi tēs trapezēs
verses.literal: Look The hand of My betrayer . . . is with Mine on the table

verses.original: ὅτι ὁ Υἱὸς μὲν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου κατὰ τὸ ὡρισμένον πορεύεται πλὴν οὐαὶ τῷ ἀνθρώπῳ ἐκείνῳ δι’ οὗ παραδίδοται
verses.transliteration: hoti ho Huios men tou anthrōpou kata to hōrismenon poreuetai plēn ouai tō anthrōpō ekeinō di’ hou paradidotai
verses.literal: Indeed the Son of Man will go as it has been determined but woe to that man who betrays Him

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτοὶ ἤρξαντο συζητεῖν πρὸς ἑαυτοὺς τὸ τίς ἄρα εἴη ἐξ αὐτῶν ὁ τοῦτο μέλλων πράσσειν
verses.transliteration: Kai autoi ērxanto syzētein pros heautous to tis ara eiē ex autōn ho touto mellōn prassein
verses.literal: Then they began to question among themselves which of them was going to do this

verses.original: Ἐγένετο δὲ καὶ φιλονεικία ἐν αὐτοῖς τὸ τίς αὐτῶν δοκεῖ εἶναι μείζων
verses.transliteration: Egeneto de kai philoneikia en autois to tis autōn dokei einai meizōn
verses.literal: A dispute also arose among the disciples as to which of them should be considered . . . the greatest

verses.original: ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Οἱ βασιλεῖς τῶν ἐθνῶν κυριεύουσιν αὐτῶν καὶ οἱ ἐξουσιάζοντες αὐτῶν εὐεργέται καλοῦνται
verses.transliteration: ho de eipen autois Hoi basileis tōn ethnōn kyrieuousin autōn kai hoi exousiazontes autōn euergetai kalountai
verses.literal: So Jesus declared . . . The kings of the Gentiles lord it over them and those in authority over them call themselves benefactors

verses.original: ὑμεῖς δὲ οὐχ οὕτως ἀλλ’ ὁ μείζων ἐν ὑμῖν γινέσθω ὡς ὁ νεώτερος καὶ ὁ ἡγούμενος ὡς ὁ διακονῶν
verses.transliteration: hymeis de ouch houtōs all’ ho meizōn en hymin ginesthō hōs ho neōteros kai ho hēgoumenos hōs ho diakonōn
verses.literal: But you shall not be like them Instead the greatest among you should be like the youngest and the one who leads like the one who serves

verses.original: τίς γὰρ μείζων ὁ ἀνακείμενος ἢ ὁ διακονῶν οὐχὶ ὁ ἀνακείμενος ἐγὼ δὲ ἐν μέσῳ ὑμῶν εἰμι ὡς ὁ διακονῶν
verses.transliteration: tis gar meizōn ho anakeimenos ē ho diakonōn ouchi ho anakeimenos egō de en mesō hymōn eimi hōs ho diakonōn
verses.literal: For who is greater the one who reclines at the table or the one who serves Is it not the one who reclines But I am among you as one who serves

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δέ ἐστε οἱ διαμεμενηκότες μετ’ ἐμοῦ ἐν τοῖς πειρασμοῖς μου
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de este hoi diamemenēkotes met’ emou en tois peirasmois mou
verses.literal: You are the ones who have stood by Me in My trials

verses.original: κἀγὼ διατίθεμαι ὑμῖν καθὼς διέθετό μοι ὁ Πατήρ μου βασιλείαν
verses.transliteration: kagō diatithemai hymin kathōs dietheto moi ho Patēr mou basileian
verses.literal: And I bestow on you a kingdom just as My Father has bestowed one on Me

verses.original: ἵνα ἔσθητε καὶ πίνητε ἐπὶ τῆς τραπέζης μου ἐν τῇ βασιλείᾳ μου καὶ καθήσεσθε ἐπὶ θρόνων τὰς δώδεκα φυλὰς κρίνοντες τοῦ Ἰσραήλ
verses.transliteration: hina esthēte kai pinēte epi tēs trapezēs mou en tē basileia mou kai kathēsesthe epi thronōn tas dōdeka phylas krinontes tou Israēl
verses.literal: so that you may eat and drink at My table in My kingdom and sit on thrones judging the twelve tribes of Israel

verses.original: Σίμων Σίμων ἰδοὺ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐξῃτήσατο ὑμᾶς τοῦ σινιάσαι ὡς τὸν σῖτον
verses.transliteration: Simōn Simōn idou ho Satanas exētēsato hymas tou siniasai hōs ton siton
verses.literal: Simon Simon - Satan has asked to sift all of you like wheat

verses.original: ἐγὼ δὲ ἐδεήθην περὶ σοῦ ἵνα μὴ ἐκλίπῃ ἡ πίστις σου καὶ σύ ποτε ἐπιστρέψας στήρισον τοὺς ἀδελφούς σου
verses.transliteration: egō de edeēthēn peri sou hina mē eklipē hē pistis sou kai sy pote epistrepsas stērison tous adelphous sou
verses.literal: But I have prayed for you, Simon that your faith will not fail And when you have turned back strengthen your brothers

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Κύριε μετὰ σοῦ ἕτοιμός εἰμι καὶ εἰς φυλακὴν καὶ εἰς θάνατον πορεύεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autō Kyrie meta sou hetoimos eimi kai eis phylakēn kai eis thanaton poreuesthai
verses.literal: Lord - said Peter I am ready to go with You even to prison and to death

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν Λέγω σοι Πέτρε οὐ φωνήσει σήμερον ἀλέκτωρ ἕως τρίς με ἀπαρνήσῃ μὴ εἰδέναι
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen Legō soi Petre ou phōnēsei sēmeron alektōr heōs tris me aparnēsē mē eidenai
verses.literal: But Jesus replied I tell you Peter the rooster will not crow today until you have denied . . . three times that you know Me

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ὅτε ἀπέστειλα ὑμᾶς ἄτερ βαλλαντίου καὶ πήρας καὶ ὑποδημάτων μή τινος ὑστερήσατε Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Οὐθενός
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen autois Hote apesteila hymas ater ballantiou kai pēras kai hypodēmatōn mē tinos hysterēsate Hoi de eipan Outhenos
verses.literal: Then Jesus asked them When I sent you out . . . without purse or bag or sandals did you lack anything Nothing - they answered

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ἀλλὰ νῦν ὁ ἔχων βαλλάντιον ἀράτω ὁμοίως καὶ πήραν καὶ ὁ μὴ ἔχων πωλησάτω τὸ ἱμάτιον αὐτοῦ καὶ ἀγορασάτω μάχαιραν
verses.transliteration: Eipen de autois Alla nyn ho echōn ballantion aratō homoiōs kai pēran kai ho mē echōn pōlēsatō to himation autou kai agorasatō machairan
verses.literal: Now however He told them the one with a purse should take it and likewise a bag and the one without . . . a sword should sell his cloak and buy one

verses.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν ὅτι τοῦτο τὸ γεγραμμένον δεῖ τελεσθῆναι ἐν ἐμοί Τό Καὶ μετὰ ἀνόμων ἐλογίσθη καὶ γὰρ τὸ περὶ ἐμοῦ τέλος ἔχει
verses.transliteration: legō gar hymin hoti touto to gegrammenon dei telesthēnai en emoi To Kai meta anomōn elogisthē kai gar to peri emou telos echei
verses.literal: For I tell you that this Scripture must be fulfilled in Me And He was numbered with the transgressors For what is written about Me is reaching its fulfillment

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Κύριε ἰδοὺ μάχαιραι ὧδε δύο Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Ἱκανόν ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan Kyrie idou machairai hōde dyo Ho de eipen autois Hikanon estin
verses.literal: So they said Look Lord here are two swords That is enough - He answered . . .

verses.original: Καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἐπορεύθη κατὰ τὸ ἔθος εἰς τὸ ὄρος τῶν Ἐλαιῶν ἠκολούθησαν δὲ αὐτῷ καὶ οἱ μαθηταί
verses.transliteration: Kai exelthōn eporeuthē kata to ethos eis to oros tōn Elaiōn ēkolouthēsan de autō kai hoi mathētai
verses.literal: Jesus went out . . . as usual . . . . . . to the Mount of Olives and the disciples followed Him

verses.original: γενόμενος δὲ ἐπὶ τοῦ τόπου εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Προσεύχεσθε μὴ εἰσελθεῖν εἰς πειρασμόν
verses.transliteration: genomenos de epi tou topou eipen autois Proseuchesthe mē eiselthein eis peirasmon
verses.literal: When He came to the place He told them Pray that you will not enter into temptation

verses.original: Καὶ αὐτὸς ἀπεσπάσθη ἀπ’ αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ λίθου βολήν καὶ θεὶς τὰ γόνατα προσηύχετο
verses.transliteration: Kai autos apespasthē ap’ autōn hōsei lithou bolēn kai theis ta gonata prosēucheto
verses.literal: And He withdrew about a stone’s throw beyond them where He knelt down . . . . . . and prayed

verses.original: λέγων Πάτερ εἰ βούλει παρένεγκε τοῦτο τὸ ποτήριον ἀπ’ ἐμοῦ πλὴν μὴ τὸ θέλημά μου ἀλλὰ τὸ σὸν γινέσθω
verses.transliteration: legōn Pater ei boulei parenenke touto to potērion ap’ emou plēn mē to thelēma mou alla to son ginesthō
verses.literal: Father if You are willing take this cup from Me Yet not My will but Yours be done

verses.original: Ὤφθη δὲ αὐτῷ ἄγγελος ἀπ’ οὐρανοῦ ἐνισχύων αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Ōphthē de autō angelos ap’ ouranou enischyōn auton
verses.literal: Then an angel from heaven appeared to Him and strengthened Him

verses.original: καὶ γενόμενος ἐν ἀγωνίᾳ ἐκτενέστερον προσηύχετο καὶ ἐγένετο ὁ ἱδρὼς αὐτοῦ ὡσεὶ θρόμβοι αἵματος καταβαίνοντες ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν
verses.transliteration: kai genomenos en agōnia ektenesteron prosēucheto kai egeneto ho hidrōs autou hōsei thromboi haimatos katabainontes epi tēn gēn
verses.literal: And in His anguish He prayed more earnestly and His sweat became like drops of blood falling to the ground

verses.original: Καὶ ἀναστὰς ἀπὸ τῆς προσευχῆς ἐλθὼν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς εὗρεν κοιμωμένους αὐτοὺς ἀπὸ τῆς λύπης
verses.transliteration: Kai anastas apo tēs proseuchēs elthōn pros tous mathētas heuren koimōmenous autous apo tēs lypēs
verses.literal: When Jesus rose from prayer and returned to the disciples He found them asleep exhausted from sorrow

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Τί καθεύδετε ἀναστάντες προσεύχεσθε ἵνα μὴ εἰσέλθητε εἰς πειρασμόν
verses.transliteration: kai eipen autois Ti katheudete anastantes proseuchesthe hina mē eiselthēte eis peirasmon
verses.literal: Why are you sleeping He asked Get up and pray so that you will not enter into temptation

verses.original: Ἔτι αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ἰδοὺ ὄχλος καὶ ὁ λεγόμενος Ἰούδας εἷς τῶν δώδεκα προήρχετο αὐτούς καὶ ἤγγισεν τῷ Ἰησοῦ φιλῆσαι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Eti autou lalountos idou ochlos kai ho legomenos Ioudas heis tōn dōdeka proērcheto autous kai ēngisen tō Iēsou philēsai auton
verses.literal: While He was still speaking a crowd arrived led by . . . the man called Judas one of the Twelve He approached Jesus to kiss Him

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἰούδα φιλήματι τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου παραδίδως
verses.transliteration: Iēsous de eipen autō Iouda philēmati ton Huion tou anthrōpou paradidōs
verses.literal: But Jesus asked him Judas are you betraying the Son of Man with a kiss

verses.original: Ἰδόντες δὲ οἱ περὶ αὐτὸν τὸ ἐσόμενον εἶπαν Κύριε εἰ πατάξομεν ἐν μαχαίρῃ
verses.transliteration: Idontes de hoi peri auton to esomenon eipan Kyrie ei pataxomen en machairē
verses.literal: Those around Jesus saw what was about to happen and said Lord should we strike with our swords

verses.original: καὶ ἐπάταξεν εἷς τις ἐξ αὐτῶν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως τὸν δοῦλον καὶ ἀφεῖλεν τὸ οὖς αὐτοῦ τὸ δεξιόν
verses.transliteration: kai epataxen heis tis ex autōn tou archiereōs ton doulon kai apheilen to ous autou to dexion
verses.literal: And one of them struck the servant of the high priest cutting off his right ear

verses.original: Ἀποκριθεὶς δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς εἶπεν Ἐᾶτε ἕως τούτου καὶ ἁψάμενος τοῦ ὠτίου ἰάσατο αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: Apokritheis de ho Iēsous eipen Eate heōs toutou kai hapsamenos tou ōtiou iasato auton
verses.literal: But Jesus answered . . . No more . . . of this And He touched the man’s ear and healed him

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ Ἰησοῦς πρὸς τοὺς παραγενομένους ἐπ’ αὐτὸν ἀρχιερεῖς καὶ στρατηγοὺς τοῦ ἱεροῦ καὶ πρεσβυτέρους Ὡς ἐπὶ λῃστὴν ἐξήλθατε μετὰ μαχαιρῶν καὶ ξύλων
verses.transliteration: Eipen de Iēsous pros tous paragenomenous ep’ auton archiereis kai stratēgous tou hierou kai presbyterous Hōs epi lēstēn exēlthate meta machairōn kai xylōn
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to the chief priests temple officers . . . . . . and elders who had come for Him Have you come out with swords and clubs as you would against an outlaw

verses.original: καθ’ ἡμέραν ὄντος μου μεθ’ ὑμῶν ἐν τῷ ἱερῷ οὐκ ἐξετείνατε τὰς χεῖρας ἐπ’ ἐμέ ἀλλ’ αὕτη ἐστὶν ὑμῶν ἡ ὥρα καὶ ἡ ἐξουσία τοῦ σκότους
verses.transliteration: kath’ hēmeran ontos mou meth’ hymōn en tō hierō ouk exeteinate tas cheiras ep’ eme all’ hautē estin hymōn hē hōra kai hē exousia tou skotous
verses.literal: Every day I was with you in the temple courts and you did not lay a hand on Me But this hour belongs to you and to the power of darkness

verses.original: Συλλαβόντες δὲ αὐτὸν ἤγαγον καὶ εἰσήγαγον εἰς τὴν οἰκίαν τοῦ ἀρχιερέως ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἠκολούθει μακρόθεν
verses.transliteration: Syllabontes de auton ēgagon kai eisēgagon eis tēn oikian tou archiereōs ho de Petros ēkolouthei makrothen
verses.literal: Then they seized Jesus led Him away and took Him into the house of the high priest And Peter followed at a distance

verses.original: Περιαψάντων δὲ πῦρ ἐν μέσῳ τῆς αὐλῆς καὶ συνκαθισάντων ἐκάθητο ὁ Πέτρος μέσος αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Periapsantōn de pyr en mesō tēs aulēs kai synkathisantōn ekathēto ho Petros mesos autōn
verses.literal: When those present had kindled a fire in the middle of the courtyard and sat down together Peter sat down among them

verses.original: ἰδοῦσα δὲ αὐτὸν παιδίσκη τις καθήμενον πρὸς τὸ φῶς καὶ ἀτενίσασα αὐτῷ εἶπεν Καὶ οὗτος σὺν αὐτῷ ἦν
verses.transliteration: idousa de auton paidiskē tis kathēmenon pros to phōs kai atenisasa autō eipen Kai houtos syn autō ēn
verses.literal: A servant girl saw him seated in the firelight and looked intently at him This man also was with Him she said

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ ἠρνήσατο λέγων Οὐκ οἶδα αὐτόν γύναι
verses.transliteration: Ho de ērnēsato legōn Ouk oida auton gynai
verses.literal: But Peter denied it Woman I do not know Him he said

verses.original: Καὶ μετὰ βραχὺ ἕτερος ἰδὼν αὐτὸν ἔφη Καὶ σὺ ἐξ αὐτῶν εἶ Ὁ δὲ Πέτρος ἔφη Ἄνθρωπε οὐκ εἰμί
verses.transliteration: Kai meta brachy heteros idōn auton ephē Kai sy ex autōn ei Ho de Petros ephē Anthrōpe ouk eimi
verses.literal: A short time later someone else saw him and said You also are one of them But Peter said Man I am not

verses.original: Καὶ διαστάσης ὡσεὶ ὥρας μιᾶς ἄλλος τις διϊσχυρίζετο λέγων Ἐπ’ ἀληθείας καὶ οὗτος μετ’ αὐτοῦ ἦν καὶ γὰρ Γαλιλαῖός ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Kai diastasēs hōsei hōras mias allos tis diischyrizeto legōn Ep’ alētheias kai houtos met’ autou ēn kai gar Galilaios estin
verses.literal: About an hour later another man insisted Certainly this man was with Him for he too is . . . a Galilean

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος Ἄνθρωπε οὐκ οἶδα ὃ λέγεις καὶ παραχρῆμα ἔτι λαλοῦντος αὐτοῦ ἐφώνησεν ἀλέκτωρ
verses.transliteration: Eipen de ho Petros Anthrōpe ouk oida ho legeis kai parachrēma eti lalountos autou ephōnēsen alektōr
verses.literal: Man I do not know what you are talking about - Peter replied And immediately while he was still speaking the rooster crowed

verses.original: καὶ στραφεὶς ὁ Κύριος ἐνέβλεψεν τῷ Πέτρῳ καὶ ὑπεμνήσθη ὁ Πέτρος τοῦ λόγου τοῦ Κυρίου ὡς εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὅτι Πρὶν ἀλέκτορα φωνῆσαι σήμερον ἀπαρνήσῃ με τρίς
verses.transliteration: kai strapheis ho Kyrios eneblepsen tō Petrō kai hypemnēsthē ho Petros tou logou tou Kyriou hōs eipen autō hoti Prin alektora phōnēsai sēmeron aparnēsē me tris
verses.literal: And the Lord turned and looked at Peter Then Peter remembered the word that the Lord had spoken to him Before the rooster crows today you will deny Me three times

verses.original: καὶ ἐξελθὼν ἔξω ἔκλαυσεν πικρῶς
verses.transliteration: kai exelthōn exō eklausen pikrōs
verses.literal: And he went outside and wept bitterly

verses.original: Καὶ οἱ ἄνδρες οἱ συνέχοντες αὐτὸν ἐνέπαιζον αὐτῷ δέροντες
verses.transliteration: Kai hoi andres hoi synechontes auton enepaizon autō derontes
verses.literal: The men who were holding Jesus began to mock Him and beat Him

verses.original: καὶ περικαλύψαντες αὐτὸν ἐπηρώτων λέγοντες Προφήτευσον τίς ἐστιν ὁ παίσας σε
verses.transliteration: kai perikalypsantes auton epērōtōn legontes Prophēteuson tis estin ho paisas se
verses.literal: They blindfolded Him and kept demanding . . . Prophesy Who hit You

verses.original: καὶ ἕτερα πολλὰ βλασφημοῦντες ἔλεγον εἰς αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai hetera polla blasphēmountes elegon eis auton
verses.literal: And they said many other blasphemous things against Him

verses.original: Καὶ ὡς ἐγένετο ἡμέρα συνήχθη τὸ πρεσβυτέριον τοῦ λαοῦ ἀρχιερεῖς τε καὶ γραμματεῖς καὶ ἀπήγαγον αὐτὸν εἰς τὸ συνέδριον αὐτῶν λέγοντες
verses.transliteration: Kai hōs egeneto hēmera synēchthē to presbyterion tou laou archiereis te kai grammateis kai apēgagon auton eis to synedrion autōn legontes
verses.literal: At daybreak the council of the elders of the people both the chief priests and scribes met together They led Jesus into their Sanhedrin and said

verses.original: Εἰ σὺ εἶ ὁ Χριστός εἰπὸν ἡμῖν Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτοῖς Ἐὰν ὑμῖν εἴπω οὐ μὴ πιστεύσητε
verses.transliteration: Ei sy ei ho Christos eipon hēmin Eipen de autois Ean hymin eipō ou mē pisteusēte
verses.literal: If You are the Christ tell us Jesus answered . . . If I tell you you will not believe

verses.original: ἐὰν δὲ ἐρωτήσω οὐ μὴ ἀποκριθῆτε
verses.transliteration: ean de erōtēsō ou mē apokrithēte
verses.literal: And if I ask you a question you will not answer

verses.original: ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν δὲ ἔσται ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου καθήμενος ἐκ δεξιῶν τῆς δυνάμεως τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: apo tou nyn de estai ho Huios tou anthrōpou kathēmenos ek dexiōn tēs dynameōs tou Theou
verses.literal: But from now on the Son of Man will be seated at the right hand of the power of God

verses.original: Εἶπαν δὲ πάντες Σὺ οὖν εἶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ Θεοῦ Ὁ δὲ πρὸς αὐτοὺς ἔφη Ὑμεῖς λέγετε ὅτι ἐγώ εἰμι
verses.transliteration: Eipan de pantes Sy oun ei ho Huios tou Theou Ho de pros autous ephē Hymeis legete hoti egō eimi
verses.literal: So they all asked Are You then the Son of God - He replied - You say that I am

verses.original: Οἱ δὲ εἶπαν Τί ἔτι ἔχομεν μαρτυρίας χρείαν αὐτοὶ γὰρ ἠκούσαμεν ἀπὸ τοῦ στόματος αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Hoi de eipan Ti eti echomen martyrias chreian autoi gar ēkousamen apo tou stomatos autou
verses.literal: Why do we need . . . any more testimony - they declared We have heard it for ourselves from His own lips
